After completing her B.Tech in 2024, Gauri was ready to begin her professional journey but needed to bridge the gap between what she had learned during her degree and the practical skills expected in a development role. She joined the STEP in JAVA program at 3RI Technologies , where her learning journey covered programming fundamentals, Java development, databases, practical projects, and career preparation . The training also helped her understand how software projects are approached and handled in professional environments. With this structured learning and practical exposure, Gauri moved forward toward her career goal and joined OmniGross Enterprises as a Software Developer . The Challenge After completing her B.Tech , Gauri Patil wanted to strengthen her practical development skills instead of depending only on what she had learned during her degree. She was looking for a structured learning path that could take her from Java fundamentals to advanced concepts while also giving her opportunities to work on practical projects. This led her to explore Java Classes in Pune that focused not just on classroom learning but also on applying Java to real development tasks. Her requirements went beyond learning Java syntax. She wanted to understand databases, web-development technologies, practical project work, and interview preparation , along with guidance that reflected actual workplace expectations. The real challenge was learning how to connect these concepts and use them to solve practical software-development problems with greater confidence. Email Phone Send The Learning Approach at 3RI Technologies Once she completed her B.Tech , Gauri began thinking about what she would need to become a software developer. Her degree had introduced her to programming, but she knew that understanding concepts in college was different from using them while working on real projects. She needed more hands-on practice with Java and related technologies, which led her to consider a Java Course in Pune where she could strengthen her skills through practical learning. That became the reason she joined the STEP in JAVA program at 3RI Technologies . The 5-month course with 10 real-time projects gave her a structured path to work through the basics and gradually take on more advanced topics. She started with Core Java, OOPs, collections, exception handling, and multithreading before moving into MySQL, JDBC, JSP, Servlets, Spring, Spring Boot, and Hibernate . Her learning also extended to HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and REST API concepts . The Learning Path of Java Classes in Pune Gauri’s learning journey was structured in stages, helping her move from the programming concepts she had encountered during her B.Tech to more practical Java development skills. The 5-month STEP in JAVA program at 3RI Technologies combines technical concepts with practical learning, projects, assessments, and interview preparation, allowing her to gradually build confidence in application development. Weeks 1–4 – Strengthening the Foundation: Gauri began with programming fundamentals, object-oriented programming concepts, operating systems, networking, and Linux. This stage helped her strengthen the technical foundation needed for further Java learning. Weeks 5–8 – Developing Core Java Skills: She then progressed into Core Java, covering classes, objects, inheritance, collections, exception handling, multithreading, and other essential programming concepts. The focus shifted from understanding concepts to applying them through coding practice. Weeks 9–12 – Connecting Java with Databases: Once her Java fundamentals became stronger, Gauri moved into MySQL, SQL, JDBC, JSP, and Servlets. This stage helped her understand how Java applications interact with databases and web components. Weeks 13–16 – Exploring Modern Java Technologies: Her learning then expanded to Spring, Spring Boot, Hibernate, and web-development concepts. Working with these technologies gave her greater exposure to how Java applications can be structured for practical development. Weeks 17–20 – Applying Skills Through Projects: In the final stage, Gauri focused on project implementation, practical assignments, assessments, and interview preparation. The project-based work gave her an opportunity to bring together the concepts and technologies covered throughout the course. These skills helped her move closer to her career goal and prepare for opportunities in the IT industry. For Gauri Patil , it was an opportunity to connect her B.Tech education with practical Java development skills and prepare for the expectations of a software development role. After completing the STEP in JAVA training, her journey progressed toward a professional opportunity at OmniGross Enterprises, where she joined as a Software Developer . During her training, the focus was on gradually building technical knowledge and applying it through practical learning. Her overall development included: Area of Learning Gauri’s Learning Experience Java programming Strengthening Core Java and object-oriented programming concepts Application development Practicing how programming concepts can be applied to software applications Database skills Working with MySQL, SQL, and Java database connectivity Java technologies Learning technologies such as JSP, Servlets, Spring, Spring Boot, and Hibernate Practical learning Applying concepts through assignments and real-time project work Career preparation Preparing for technical discussions, assessments, and interviews The purpose of this structured approach was to help Gauri move beyond theoretical understanding and develop a more practical view of Java-based software development . Working through different technologies and projects allowed her to connect programming, databases, web development, and frameworks as parts of a broader development process. Her progression can be summarized simply: B.Tech in 2024 → identified practical skill gaps → joined STEP in JAVA → developed Java and project skills → prepared for professional opportunities → Software Developer at OmniGross Enterprises Her opportunity at OmniGross Enterprises marked an important stage in this journey.
